standing: presentation baseline only — craft continuity, never semantic truth
lineage_chain: O:I global → Epi global → bimba-corpus-base (this file) → family profile (M-subsystem-grounded) → branch variant → scene override
source_law: coordinates are carried verbatim in label text and binding records — compound #N-k, #N.k and #N-k-j/l forms exactly as the registry writes them

artifact/scene/entity ids use a mangled form (separators folded to '-') because the engine id grammar excludes '#' and '/' (Point-Cloud-Demo #6); the exact ref always also appears in name/text and in the binding record

a visual relation never manufactures graph truth; only registry relation refs (bimba:relation:*) may be cited as source relations, and structural membership is cited as membership (registry node id + parent), never dressed up as a typed relation
layout is presentation: constellation grain and graph membership come from the registry, never from where formations are placed
colour and material encode presentation families only; a repeated colour association is never a claimed source relation
one artifact is one editable oi.journey v1 document; no new scene schema, no runtime

params.note: engine defaults for the remaining params unless the coordinate's own structure warrants otherwise

scene_rhythm.note: a scene holds long enough for its coordinate to be read

entities.governing_formation: one per scene unless the coordinate's own structure carries more (poles, anchors, centres, stages)
entities.label_grammar: each formation names its exact coordinate in text/name; entity ids use the mangled form

what_families_may_vary: force kinds where the source structure warrants them (poles, orbits, centres)
2d/3d view where situated depth is the point

instrument_binding.m_prime_note: every artifact names its M′ instrument relation (alignment §1-2, lock §13 cross-cut bridges) in its description and binding record
instrument_binding.depth_note: first corpus cut uses real registry depths only: depth-2 branch families (the profiles), depth-3 leaves (the artifacts), plus the registry's own '/' aperture notation at depth 3 — no invented depth ontology
instrument_binding.runtime_seam: O-I #366 (runtime Wiki→Expression materialisation) is the named gate; until it lands, source identity travels in artifact descriptions + bindings/bimba-*.binding.json
